description: The image displays two pie charts, titled "All Changes" and "All Errors," which compare the distribution of different types of spelling corrections and errors in Chinese text. The chart on the left, "All Changes," shows five categories: a large light green segment representing 50%, a yellow segment at 26%, a dark green segment at 4%, a light blue segment at 5%, and a small brown segment at 1%. The chart on the right, "All Errors," also shows five categories: a large light green segment at 56%, a yellow segment at 29%, a dark green segment at 3%, a light blue segment at 5%, and a small brown segment at 1%. A legend on the right side of the image associates the colors with the labels P, PW, RW, N, and NW, respectively. The segments in both charts are labeled with their percentage values, and the light green segment in "All Changes" and the light green segment in "All Errors" are visually emphasized by being slightly separated from the rest of the pie. The overall layout suggests a comparison between the types of changes made and the types of errors present in a Chinese spelling correction system.
